title: India's exports just jumped 23% in a single month
sources: Business Today - India exports rise to $44.4 billion in September, trade deficit narrows to $30.21 billion
Deccan Herald - India's trade deficit widens to $30.21 billion in September, citing Commerce Ministry data
caption:
India's exports just jumped 23% in a single month - against the same month last year.

India's merchandise exports rose 23.04% year-on-year to $44.40 billion in September 2026, up from $36.08 billion in September 2025, per Commerce Ministry data. The Commerce Secretary credited engineering goods, electronics, petroleum products and chemicals, with oil exports up 32% and non-oil exports up 22%. Cumulative exports for April-September this fiscal year reached $259.89 billion, up 18.51% year-on-year.

A single strong month can be a fluke. Six straight months of double-digit growth is a trend.

Sources: Business Today, Deccan Herald, citing Commerce Ministry data (2026)
